text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking around the
academy when...

text_block_list.name: Opponents
text_block_list.text:
What? Already? You're usually itchin'
for one
more.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I just don't feel like it today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa usually loves a good

competition. She might still be fatigued
from her
recent races.
